subject: bellows-camera character
pose: 一手做小幅招呼，双脚错开
requested_medium: leather bellows and wood collectible render
art_direction: 老式皮腔相机长出短靴与布手套，镜头不是眼睛，机顶小脸一本正经摆姿势。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create an original bellows-camera mascot with a walnut body, dark folded leather bellows, brass corners, and short suede boots. Keep the front lens as a lens; put a small solemn face on the upper housing so it does not become a giant eyeball. One gloved hand gives a tiny wave while the feet take a deliberately posed stance. Show leather creases and wood grain under warm side light. Use a deep muted teal studio field and no tripod, labels, photographic prints, or historical brand cues. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
